title_zh: 论文给出的唯一安装 tag 不存在，版本标识四处冲突
summary_zh: 安装命令要求 `v1.0.1`，但公开 Git 仓库没有该 branch/tag；提交 `feeccfb` 实际标为 `v0.1.1`，`pyproject.toml` 为 `0.1.1`，包内 `__version__` 仍为 `0.1.0`，而 Zenodo metadata 又写 `v1.0.1`。读者照论文复制命令会立即失败。

locations.excerpt: git clone --branch v1.0.1 https://github.com/AadarshSingh0/HEPLocalAgent.git
\newcommand{\agentversion}{\texttt{1.0.1}}
The release described in this work is v1.0.1 (commit \texttt{feeccfb})

evidence.recompute: git clone --depth 1 --branch v1.0.1 ... -> fatal: Remote branch v1.0.1 not found; git ls-remote shows feeccfb10... at refs/tags/v0.1.1; pyproject.toml=0.1.1; src/hep_agent/__init__.py=0.1.0; Zenodo 21934091 metadata.version=v1.0.1 and related Git URL ends in v0.1.1.

refutation_attempt: 核对了 heads、tags、精确提交、Zenodo metadata 与两个包版本来源；未找到 v1.0.1 ref。提交本身可获取，但论文命令仍不可执行。
reviewer_impact_zh: 软件论文的首要复现入口失效，会直接削弱代码可用性与 artifact credibility。

fix.proposed: Choose one canonical release identity. Either publish a v1.0.1 tag at the archived commit and update both package version sources, or revise every manuscript/Zenodo occurrence to v0.1.1 and change the clone command accordingly.
fix.rationale_zh: 不能替作者决定产品版本语义，但 Git、包、论文与 Zenodo 必须指向同一个不可变 release。

title_zh: 两次重复不足以断言差异“反映”Monte Carlo 统计涨落
summary_zh: 两组 cross section 各只有两次重复，0.3% 的一致性与 Monte Carlo 统计涨落相容，但没有给出每次积分误差或更多重复来排除环境、收敛或实现差异。当前因果措辞强于证据。

locations.excerpt: The repeats used independent random seeds, so this spread reflects Monte Carlo statistical variation rather than a difference in the constructed workflow.

refutation_attempt: 检查了附近是否报告 MadGraph integration uncertainties 或更多重复；未找到。独立 seed 支持该解释，但不能独占地证明它。
reviewer_impact_zh: 方法学审稿人会要求把因果断言降为与统计涨落相容。

fix.proposed: The repeats used independent random seeds, and the observed 0.3% differences are consistent with Monte Carlo statistical variation; with two repeats per process, this check is not designed to isolate all sources of runtime variation.
fix.rationale_zh: 保留观察结果，同时把未被实验排除的替代解释说清楚。

title_zh: 核心结果仍由已知有误的 v1.2 scorer 产生，尚未用 v1.2.1 重算
summary_zh: 作者明确知道 v1.2.1 修正了四个 request family 中两个 family 的 native scorers，却仍让摘要、正文和结论使用 v1.2 数量。论文推测重算只会改变 unnormalized view，但没有执行重算，因此核心数字仍依赖可消除的 measurement error。

locations.excerpt: All workflow-construction counts reported in this paper are therefore v1.2 quantities.
The companion benchmark paper subsequently corrected two native scorers in v1.2.1
have not been rescored under the corrected v1.2.1 scorers

evidence.recompute: 2 of 4 evaluated workflow families use corrected scorers. The paper itself predicts v1.2.1 will raise unnormalized counts and narrow the 7/47 -> 19/47 gap; the exact corrected counts are missing.

refutation_attempt: 检查了 normalized operations 是否已经等价覆盖全部修正。作者仅论证 normalized counts 不变；没有提供实际 v1.2.1 rescore 或 corrected unmodified counts。
reviewer_impact_zh: 审稿人很难接受已知 scorer bug 可以修但核心实验仍不重跑。

fix.proposed: Rescore every archived artifact with v1.2.1, regenerate the abstract, Figure 3, Tables 6/9, conclusion, and all prose counts, and retain v1.2 only as a clearly labeled sensitivity analysis.
fix.rationale_zh: 这是离线 scorer 重算，不需要重新调用模型，成本相对低且能消除核心 measurement ambiguity。

title_zh: 91.5% 是“收到可用响应之后”的条件正确率，不是本地系统端到端可靠率
summary_zh: 60 个计划 B--C cases 中只有 47 个得到 usable response；13 个 Llama cases 全因 300 秒 timeout 被排除。论文透明披露了排除，但摘要的 43/47 很容易被读成完整本地系统可靠率，尤其标题强调 on your own computer。应并列报告 availability、conditional correctness 与 planned-case success。

locations.excerpt: The paired B--C study planned 60 model--request cases and obtained usable responses for 47 of them.
On the 47 semantic units ... 43 (91.5%)
In a same-response comparison on 47 evaluable model--request cases

evidence.recompute: availability = 47/60 = 78.3%; normalized full-pipeline conditional correctness = 43/47 = 91.5%; planned-case success upper-bound when infrastructure-unavailable counts as failure = 43/60 = 71.7%. Unmodified corresponding values: 19/47 = 40.4% conditional and 19/60 = 31.7% planned-case.

refutation_attempt: 核对了作者是否把 13 个 timeout 错算为 model semantic failures；作者没有这样做且解释充分。finding 因而不是说 43/47 算错，而是三种 estimand 未在 headline 处并列。
reviewer_impact_zh: 系统/软件审稿人会区分 conditional semantic quality 和 user-observed end-to-end availability。

fix.proposed: Report three quantities together: response availability (47/60, 78.3%), workflow correctness conditional on a usable response (43/47, 91.5%), and planned-case success under the tested serving setup (43/60, 71.7%). Keep clear that the last quantity conflates serving and semantic failures.
fix.rationale_zh: 不否定 paired semantic comparison，但避免把条件正确率当成真实部署可靠率。

title_zh: 47 个 unit 来自仅四个底层 workflow family，headline 未显示 cluster 级稳健性
summary_zh: 20 个 valid requests 是四个 workflow family 各五个 paraphrases，再与模型组合。把 model--request unit 直接汇总会让同一 physics task 的近相关 paraphrases 看起来像独立覆盖。论文承认固定测试集不能外推，但缺少按 family/model 的分层表，无法判断 32 个 fail-to-pass 是否集中于一两个 family。

locations.excerpt: The evaluation uses 20 valid requests from four workflow families ... Each family is represented by five paraphrases
the paired transitions are 32 fail-to-pass, 11 pass-to-pass, 4 fail-to-fail, and no pass-to-fail

evidence.recompute: nominal semantic units = 47; underlying valid workflow families = 4; paraphrases per family = 5; model-level N = 20, 20, 7. Aggregate transitions do not reveal family concentration.

refutation_attempt: 查找了 per-family transition table、cluster bootstrap 或 leave-one-family-out sensitivity；正文、附录与图中均未提供。作者的 threats-to-validity 降低了过度外推，但没有补上稳健性证据。
reviewer_impact_zh: 核心效果可能是某个 task family 的 deterministic correction 重复命中五个 paraphrases，而非跨任务普遍改善。

fix.proposed: Add a model-by-family table for A/B/C and B->C transitions, report leave-one-family-out results, and treat workflow family (not paraphrase) as the resampling cluster if uncertainty intervals are shown.
fix.rationale_zh: 现有结果可能仍成立；需要展示效果没有被单一 family 驱动。

title_zh: 57 个 false acceptances 的 severity 结论没有可复算定义
summary_zh: 附录称 9 个 low、48 个 moderate、没有 high/critical，但论文没有给 severity rubric、标注流程或逐例映射。与此同时正文说 17 个 case 改变了 explicit scientific intent。原始 outcome counts 可复算，severity 安慰性结论不可复算。

locations.excerpt: Nine are classified as low severity and 48 as moderate; none is classified as high or critical severity.
In 17 cases this changed an explicit part of the scientific intent.

refutation_attempt: 全文检索 severity、rubric、critical、annotation；除结论句外没有操作化定义。
reviewer_impact_zh: 没有 rubric 的 severity 标签会被视为主观淡化风险。

fix.proposed: Either add the complete severity rubric, annotator procedure, and case-level labels to the evaluation materials, or remove the low/moderate/high/critical sentence and report only the reproducible failure mechanisms and intent-change counts.
fix.rationale_zh: 原始类别和计数已经足够有信息量，无法审计的 severity 不应额外承担结论。

title_zh: 与 HEPTAPOD 等相邻系统的独特边界只有叙述，没有可核对比较
summary_zh: 论文正确引用了 HEPTAPOD、MadAgents、FERMIACC、DarkAgents，但“focus here is different”主要靠文字宣告。HEPTAPOD 同样强调 schema-validated、auditable、human-in-the-loop workflow；当前稿件没有 capability matrix 或共同任务比较来钉死 HEPLocalAgent 的独特增量。

locations.excerpt: Several recent projects have explored language-model assistance and agency in high-energy and astroparticle physics.
The focus here is different. HEPLocalAgent deliberately restricts the role of the language model

refutation_attempt: 核对了四篇被引工作的摘要与稿件定位。研究目标确有差别，尤其本稿强调本地小模型和 deterministic artifact builder；但差异没有结构化到可逐项核对的 claim。
reviewer_impact_zh: 相邻工作的作者或领域审稿人可能把贡献评价为已有 schema-mediated HEP agent 的工程变体。

fix.proposed: Add a cited capability matrix comparing model authority, artifact construction, shell execution, local/offline deployment, validation, clarification, audit trail, and empirical evaluation. State one falsifiable novelty sentence and, if feasible, run one shared MadGraph request through the closest public baseline.
fix.rationale_zh: 把“different”改成可证伪、可比较的增量，能显著提高 novelty 可辩护性。

title_zh: Appendix C 首页下半页大面积空白，图被整体推到下一页
summary_zh: 渲染后的第 21 页在 Table 7 后留下约半页空白，Figure 5 独占下一页上部。正文没有内容缺失，但版面显得未完成并把全文扩到 24 页。

locations.excerpt: \begin{table}[H]
\begin{figure}[H]

refutation_attempt: 逐页检查 21--22 页；空白不是 intentional section break，也不是编译丢失内容，而是连续使用 [H] 固定浮动体造成。
reviewer_impact_zh: 不会改变科学结论，但会降低软件论文的完成度观感。

fix.proposed: Replace one or both [H] specifiers with [tbp], or move the explanatory paragraph before Figure 5 so LaTeX can fill page 21 while keeping the figure near its first reference.
fix.rationale_zh: 允许正常浮动即可回收空白；需重新看图表相邻关系。

title_zh: 两张有信息量的 appendix 表没有在正文中显式引用
summary_zh: Table 4 和 Table 6 虽紧邻说明文字，但没有 `\ref`；读者无法从关于 request families 与 coverage 的论述跳到对应表，自动交叉引用检查也把它们识别为 orphan floats。

locations.excerpt: \label{tab:eval-families}
\label{tab:eval-coverage}

refutation_attempt: 检查 labels、refs 与相邻段落；表内容确实被文字描述，但没有编号引用。

fix.proposed: Refer explicitly to Table~\ref{tab:eval-families} in the request-collection paragraph and Table~\ref{tab:eval-coverage} in the coverage paragraph.
fix.rationale_zh: 不改内容，只补可导航引用。

summary_zh: preamble 在第 4 行和第 14 行重复 `\usepackage{tabularx}`。当前编译不受影响，但应删去一个以保持 source hygiene。

locations.excerpt: \usepackage{tabularx}
\usepackage{tabularx}

refutation_attempt: 确认两行均在同一 preamble 且没有 option 差异。
reviewer_impact_zh: 不影响 PDF，只是源码清洁度。

title_zh: 采集器称 11 个正文数字不在所引表中
summary_zh: 该候选由 nearest-reference heuristic 误把第 72--77 行数字锚到较早提到的 Table 7；这些数字实际由 Figure 3、Table 9 和本段 paired evaluation 支持。

locations.excerpt: On the 47 semantic units ...

refutation_attempt: 逐个复算百分比，并在 Figure 3 与 Table 9 找到 47、7、19、11、43、32 等数；0.639/0.842 只在 prose 中，未被错误声称来自 Table 7。
reviewer_impact_zh: 无；不进入报告问题清单。

title_zh: Table 9 的 N=20 与 ready denominator=19 看似矛盾
summary_zh: 正文解释了一个 external-scorer-passing artifact 被 agent 的 output-name check 阻止，因此 Qwen3 有 20 个 scorer cases 但只有 19 个 ready units；总计同理为 46。

locations.excerpt: Qwen3-Coder-Next ... 20/20 ... 0/19
one of the 43 scorer-passing full-agent artifacts is blocked by an overly restrictive output-name check

evidence.recompute: ready units = 47 semantic units - 1 blocked scorer-pass = 46; Qwen3 ready units = 20 - 1 = 19.

refutation_attempt: 查找了 denominator 定义和相反方向 disagreement；正文给出精确的一例 blocked scorer-pass，算术闭合。
reviewer_impact_zh: 无；定义稍复杂但不矛盾。

title_zh: 自动估计称 Figure 2 文字不可读
summary_zh: 自动水平投影把图标和细线误当成 0.48pt 文本。300dpi crop 与最终第 7 页人工检查显示主要 labels 清楚可读；唯一保留的弱建议是源位图有效 DPI 272.3，略低于 300。

locations.excerpt: \includegraphics[width=0.60\linewidth]{figures/Validation.png}

refutation_attempt: 在最终 page-07.png 与 300dpi crop 上查看标题、步骤、标签和 caption；没有观察到自动估计声称的不可读正文。
reviewer_impact_zh: 无 major 问题；若方便可导出矢量版本或 >=300dpi 位图。

fix.proposed: Optional: export Validation.png as PDF/SVG or at least 1128 px wide for the current 3.761-inch placement.
fix.rationale_zh: 达到 300dpi 需 3.761*300≈1128 px；当前 1024 px 仍肉眼可读。
